description: This file defines the 'LeaveWithDaysLeft' data transfer object (DTO) class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It encapsulates leave-related information, including leave ID, date, duration, status, type, employee number, and remaining days, providing getter and setter methods for each property.

classes.name: LeaveWithDaysLeft
classes.description: A DTO class that represents leave information along with days left for an employee, used within the OrangeHRM leave plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method to initialize LeaveWithDaysLeft with all relevant leave details.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave record.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date associated with the leave.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date associated with the leave.

methods.name: getLengthHours
methods.description: Returns the length of leave in hours.

methods.name: setLengthHours
methods.description: Sets the length of leave in hours.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the length of leave in days.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the length of leave in days.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the leave.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the leave.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave type.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave type.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the leave.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number associated with the leave.

methods.name: getDaysLeft
methods.description: Returns the number of days left for the leave.

methods.name: setDaysLeft
methods.description: Sets the number of days left for the leave.
